experiment: SGD and Adam on a shared head with frozen features (Appendix G.8)
task: CIFAR-10 bird/cat; four-image bags whose counts of cats cycle through 1, 2, 3; only the counts supervise training
features: Frozen ResNet-18 features, per-image L2 normalization, appended bias, all 513 coordinates divided by sqrt(2); the 96 inputs are the first 96 of each 1,024-input training set
optimizers: SGD without momentum or weight decay; Adam with betas (0.9, 0.999), epsilon 1e-8, no weight decay; the same minibatch order for both
schedule: Cosine decay of the step size to 1% of its initial value over the epochs
objective: Mean negative log exact bag-count evidence
fitted: All training counts correct, mean bag evidence at least 0.95, and every predicted label has probability at least 0.90
